voice-statement-no-interpretation.notes: One-line conditional statement with the §3b-cond banner; bare claim, no interpretation embedded.

fit-section-chapter.notes: Wigner-term coefficient [5]_q!·m_e in the BW mass formula; mass-theory placement correct.

wall-side-statement.notes: Statement is the q-factorial coefficient (algebraic); the q₀/m_e evaluation is the archimedean side, handled in the .lean.

wall-side-proof.notes: No narrative Proof. body in the .md (bare conditional statement).

proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: wigner-coefficient-derivation.lean:35-44: theorem proves |wignerCoefficient 5 q₀ m_e - 68.896|/68.896 < 0.03 (a 3% near-match bound), via an axiom
proof-narrative-lean-equiv.notes: The .md states the Wigner coefficient IS [5]_q!·m_e (exact identification); the Lean proves only a 3% closeness of [5]_q!·m_e to a fitted 68.896 MeV (and via wigner_coefficient_axiom) — a different, weaker, approximate claim.

proof-statement-integrity.notes: The Lean substitutes a 3%-near-a-fitted-value bound for the .md's structural-equality claim; the formalized statement is materially different (and weaker) than the proposition.

proof-no-self-assuming-projection.notes: The theorem is a verbatim projection of an axiom whose signature equals its conclusion; honest as an external-axiom encoding but adds nothing.

proof-no-trivial-true.evidence: wigner-coefficient-derivation.lean:77-83: wigner_coefficient_conditional concludes ∀c, ∃value, 0 ≤ value (satisfied by value:=0)
proof-no-trivial-true.notes: The conditional theorem's goal ∃value, 0≤value is a tautology (value=0 works); the class field coeffs_are_q_rational similarly only asserts ∃value, value=r·m_e (existentially trivial). Neither captures 'coefficient = [5]_q!·m_e'.

proof-no-false-premise.notes: hme:0≤m_e and the class instance are satisfiable; no False premise.

proof-no-unused-hypotheses.notes: In wigner_coefficient the q₀/m_e hypotheses feed the axiom; in the conditional, the class field and hme are used (to get value≥0).

proof-no-decide-masking.notes: No decide; the masking is the vacuous existential (flagged under trivial-true) and the axiom.

da-false-claim.notes: [5]_q! = [2]_q[3]_q[4]_q[5]_q is correct ([1]_q=1); the conditional statement itself is not false.

da-vacuous.notes: The §3b-cond conditional theorem is vacuous: its goal ∃value,0≤value holds for value=0 regardless of the Wigner-coefficient content; the class encodes only an existentially-trivial ratio assertion.

da-circular.notes: Conditional on conj:q-integer-mass-formula; not back-fitting the coefficient to itself in the prose.

da-overclaim.evidence: wigner-coefficient-derivation.md:2-4: "has coefficient [5]_q!·m_e" vs lean:26 comment "[5]_q!·m_e ≈ 67.1 MeV (2.6% from fitted 68.9)"
da-overclaim.notes: The .md presents [5]_q!·m_e as the exact Wigner coefficient (approximate-as-exact); the Lean reveals it is a ~2.6–3% NEAR-MATCH to a FITTED 68.896 MeV target, which the .md omits entirely. The structural-identification framing overstates an empirical near-match to a fit.

da-hidden-dof.evidence: wigner-coefficient-derivation.lean:38: target 68.896 is a 'fitted' BW Wigner coefficient
da-hidden-dof.notes: The comparison target 68.896 MeV is a fitted value; the .md does not disclose it, so a reader sees only the structural [5]_q!·m_e form without the fitted anchor it is matched against.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Σ dim_q(λ)²=[5]_q! Wedderburn-Artin trace identity (Lean docstring) supports the [5]_q! structural form; the gap is the omitted near-match disclosure, not a logic break.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.evidence: wigner-coefficient-derivation.lean:40-44 (3% bound on fitted 68.896, axiom-backed) vs .md exact [5]_q!·m_e identification
da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: Lean proves a 3% near-match to a fitted value (via axiom) plus a vacuous ∃value,0≤value; the .md asserts an exact structural equality — divergent claims.

da-citation-misuse.notes: Lean cites [manuscript] conj:q-integer-mass-formula; the Wedderburn-Artin Σdim_q²=[n]_q! identity is correctly used.

da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: [5]_q!, the Wigner term index (term 9), and the conditional dependency on conj:q-integer-mass-formula are clear.

da-empirical-fragility.notes: [5]_q!·m_e is a 2.6–3% near-match to a FITTED 68.896 MeV — comfortably inside fit noise for a 16-atom binding fit; presenting it as the coefficient (md) conceals that it is a loose empirical near-match. Also an internal inconsistency: comment says 67.1 MeV (2.6%) while the bound is <3% of 68.896.

da-physical-implausibility.notes: Wigner-energy term coefficient ~68.9 MeV order-of-magnitude is reasonable for the BW asymmetry term scale.

da-reproducibility.evidence: wigner-coefficient-derivation.lean:35-38: numerical near-match asserted via axiom, no witness JSON cited
da-reproducibility.notes: The [5]_q!·m_e ≈ 67.1/68.896 numbers are asserted via an axiom with no referenced reproducible witness; the 67.1-vs-68.896 figures are internally inconsistent.

da-referee-verdict.notes: The [5]_q! algebra is correct, but the block conflates an exact structural form with a loose empirical near-match to a fitted value, and the Lean is axiom-backed + vacuous.
